title: Tesla's World Wireless drawings show wingless craft

tellings.quote: His drawings of the world wireless system are full of UFOs.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla's drawings for his World Wireless system, a plan to send power and signals through the air without wires, are said to be "full of UFOs", meaning wingless flying craft. A writer named Jason Jorjani tells Michels this as his own reading of the drawings, without pointing to a particular sheet. If true, it would mean Tesla was picturing such craft as part of his designs.
